 Dated this the 14th day of November, 2025  JUDGMENT

The above Writ Petition (C) is filed with the following prayers:
"a.

To issue a writ in the nature of mandamus or any other appropriate writ, order or direction to stop the illegal construction carrying out by the 8th respondent in property belongs to the 9th respondent bearing in 08.14 Ar in Sy No.288/5, 10.5 Ar in Sy No 288/7, Thandapper No 51007 in Thiruvananthapuram Taluk,
Thiruvananthapuram District at the earliest within a time limit framed by this Hon'ble High court.

b. To issue a writ in the nature of mandamus or any other appropriate writ, order or direction commanding to take further action against the 8th respondent as per the report filed by the 7 th respondent to 6th respondent at the earliest within a time limit framed by this Hon'ble High court."

[SIC]
2.

The main prayer in this writ petition is to issue a direction to stop the alleged illegal construction carried out by the 8th respondent in the property, which, according to the petitioner,
2025:KER:87452 WP(C) NO.24850 OF 2025 belongs to the 9 respondent.
A counter affidavit is filed by the 8 th th and 9th respondents, submitting that they have a license and permit.
The counsel for the 8th and 9th respondents also takes me through Ext.R8(i) judgment of this Court.
The Standing Counsel appearing for the 3rd and 4th respondents takes me through Ext.R4(b).
A statement is filed by the 4 th respondent, the Corporation.
It will be better to extract paragraph No.6 of the statement.

" 6. However, it is submitted that during the site inspection, it was noticed that the shed was constructed illegally, with sheet roof of 21.535 m2, 158.145 m2 included in 17968 m2 and also with using wood and thatch 25 m 2, 200.305 m2 included in 223.765 m2.
Against this violation, provisional order was issued on 16.07.2025 and further proceedings are initiated.

A true copy of the provisional order dated 16.07.2025 is produced herewith and marked as Annexure-R4(b). "
3.
In the light of the above, no direction is issued in this writ petition.
The Corporation will proceed with Ext.R4(b) in accordance with the law.
I make it clear that the 8 th and 9th respondents can submit their explanation in the light of Ext.R8(i) and convince the Corporation authority that there is no violation.
